decisions.reason: Copper-coated glass substrates under the publicly announced ACT platform sit close to the core offer and fit the strategy of higher-value packaging, so the firm has committed to them visibly and would keep them despite only vague market evidence.

VLIS was launched only in 2024 with its own dedicated page and positioned as a next-generation semiconductor solution central to the announced shift toward proprietary technologies, so heavy investment and public commitment make dropping it very unlikely.
